# ADR 0002: PostgreSQL full-text search first; MongoDB optional for narratives

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Consumer complaints triage and SLA service

## Context

Narratives are long free text; most queries combine text with structured filters.

## Decision

Use tsvector + GIN in PostgreSQL by default; allow MongoDB for narratives as a documented, measured choice.

## Consequences

One store for most learners; comparison is an explicit learning goal.

## Alternatives considered

Elasticsearch (another cluster to run).
